entities.summary: Quincy Douby is an American-born, naturalized Montenegrin former professional basketball player. At 6 ft 3 in (1.91 m), 175 pounds (79 kg), Douby played shooting guard for the Rutgers Scarlet Knights. The Sacramento Kings made him the 19th selection of the 2006 NBA draft.
